title: a genetic algorithm for the optimization of multi-threshold trading strategies in the directional changes paradigm
core_idea: Propose a novel genetic algorithm to optimize and prioritize conflicting recommendations from multiple trading strategies derived from the directional changes (DC) event-based paradigm, where strategies are profiled across varying DC thresholds.
tldr: Develop and evaluate a genetic algorithm that combines and prioritizes recommendations from eight DC-based trading strategies profiled across multiple thresholds, analyzed on 200 NYSE stocks to assess trading performance.
